sources.title: Novum Testamentum Graece NA29 — official product record
sources.claimLimit: Edition identity, forthcoming status, publisher date and edition-level features only; no book/apparatus body inspection.

sources.title: Greek New Testament GNT6 — official product record
sources.claimLimit: Publisher-level claims about current GNT6, relation to future NA29, apparatus purpose and newly included papyri only.

sources.title: H. A. G. Houghton, A Textual Commentary on the Greek New Testament
sources.claimLimit: Book scope and intended relation to GNT6/NA28/NA29 only; no individual 1 Peter entry treated as inspected.

sources.title: INTF — ECM Catholic Letters textual changes and CBGM information
sources.claimLimit: INTF-level statements about ECM Catholic Letters, NA28 changes, split primary lines and CBGM; not a substitute for exact apparatus inspection at a specific verse.

sources.title: INTF online textual commentary guidelines
sources.claimLimit: Methodological guidance; Acts examples do not directly prove Catholic-Letters readings.

sources.title: Thomas L. Constable, Notes on 1 Peter
sources.claimLimit: Official route and work identity; passage claims require direct section inspection.

sources.title: Comentários Bíblicos Expositivos Constable — Portuguese official corpus
sources.claimLimit: Confirms official Portuguese 1 Pedro route and stated study/teaching permissions; does not license wholesale bot republication or alteration.

sources.title: F. J. A. Hort, The First Epistle of St Peter I.1–II.17
sources.claimLimit: Public-domain availability and bibliographic identity established; passage-level claims require reading exact pages.

sources.title: John Lillie, Lectures on the First and Second Epistles of Peter
sources.claimLimit: Public-domain scan identity/extent; exact exegetical claims require targeted page inspection.

sources.title: Robert Leighton, Practical Commentary upon the First Epistle General of Peter
sources.claimLimit: Historical/pastoral source; not modern textual or social-history authority.

sources.title: G. Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament
sources.claimLimit: Historic lexicon; useful legal lexical control but not a replacement for BDAG/current lexical scholarship.

sources.title: A. T. Robertson, A Grammar of the Greek New Testament in the Light of Historical Research
sources.claimLimit: Historic reference grammar; individual syntactic claims still require exact page/context and modern control for nontrivial conclusions.

sources.title: Moulton and Milligan, Vocabulary of the Greek Testament
sources.claimLimit: Papyri parallels can inform semantic range; documentary parallel does not determine meaning in 1 Peter by itself.

sources.title: Katie Marcar, The Quotations of Isaiah in 1 Peter: A Text-Critical Analysis
sources.claimLimit: Six target Isaiah quotations and article-level conclusion may be described; detailed argument/page attribution requires article-body inspection.

sources.title: Douw G. Breed, The use of Exodus 19–24 in 1 Peter 1:2
sources.claimLimit: A serious proposal for Exodus background in 1:2; not promoted to explicit quotation without independent analysis.

sources.title: Christoph Stenschke, Reading First Peter in the Context of Early Christian Mission
sources.claimLimit: Supports Stenschke's Gentile-audience/mission/identity argument as scholarship; does not make that reconstruction a direct textual fact.

sources.title: Gene L. Green, The Use of the Old Testament for Christian Ethics in 1 Peter
sources.claimLimit: OT/ethics scholarly control; exact claims require section-level citation.

sources.title: Peter J. Gurry, A Critical Examination of the Coherence-Based Genealogical Method in the Catholic Epistles
sources.claimLimit: Summary-level methodological criticism; not a substitute for ECM data and not a claim that CBGM is invalid.

sources.title: John H. Elliott, Elders as leaders in 1 Peter and the early Church
sources.claimLimit: Leadership-vocabulary/exegetical control; broader ecclesiological reconstruction remains the author's analysis.

sources.title: Gert Breed, The diakonia of the elder according to 1 Peter
sources.claimLimit: Supports the author's connection of 4:7–11 and 5:1–4 and shepherd/oversight analysis; do not turn one article into polity consensus.

sources.title: Duane F. Watson, 1 Peter: Contested Issues
sources.claimLimit: May identify the chapter's surveyed issues and abstract-level framing only; no detailed attribution without chapter body.

sources.title: Travis B. Williams, Suffering from a Critical Oversight: The Persecutions of 1 Peter within Modern Scholarship
sources.claimLimit: Abstract supports the statement that a localized/sporadic-hostility consensus exists and that Williams critiques its history; detailed alternative model remains HOLD.

sources.title: Fergus J. King, Exiles, Not Enemies: Petrine Self-Determination in the Face of Empire
sources.claimLimit: Recent historical/social interpretation; not direct evidence that Peter's addressees held a specific Roman legal exile status.

sources.title: Chu Luan Poh, The social world of 1 Peter: socio-historical and exegetical studies
sources.claimLimit: Acquisition/read queue only until targeted body inspection.

sources.title: William J. Bynum, Ongoing Exile in 1 Peter
sources.claimLimit: Current dissertation proposal/argument from abstract; not peer-reviewed consensus.

sources.title: Ian James Hales, Anchored in Identity: Opposition and the Identity of the People of God in 1 Peter
sources.claimLimit: Useful conservative thematic control; exact chapter claims require body reading.

sources.title: Dennis E. Johnson, Fire in God's House: Imagery from Malachi 3 in Peter's Theology of Suffering (1 Pet 4:12–19)
sources.claimLimit: Title/topic verified; Malachi-3 detailed argument remains full-body HOLD.

sources.title: The Master's Seminary Doctrinal Statement
sources.claimLimit: Institutional/project theology including church-Israel distinction, millennial kingdom, Israel future and elder doctrine; not neutral lexical evidence.

sources.title: The Master's Seminary Journal Archive
sources.claimLimit: Article identities/themes verified from archive; article-specific argument requires body inspection.

sources.title: TMS Israel Study Trip doctrinal perspective
sources.claimLimit: Institutional statement of futuristic/dispensational/premillennial teaching perspective only.
